title: Pointwise triple ergodic averages with distinct integer slopes under mixing
exact_target: For every invertible mixing probability-preserving transformation T, every three pairwise distinct nonzero integers a,b,c, and bounded measurable f,g,h, do $(1/N)sum_{n=1}^N$ $f(T^{an}x)g(T^{bn}x)h(T^{cn}x)$ converge almost everywhere to (integral f)(integral g)(integral h), including mixed-sign slopes?
